description: Monthly averages of one or several instruments between two months (DSI since 2006, the others since 1990), with the zone of each month: dollar index, crisis meter, market shock, market anomalies, market-top and recession risk. Use for trends and to see what the instruments showed around past events.

instrument.description: dsi — Dollar System Index; crisis — Crisis meter; market_shock — market shock; anomalies — market anomalies (% of 18 series); top_risk — market-top risk; recession_risk — US recession risk

instruments.description: Several instruments at once (instead of instrument)
